definitions.explanation: Showing an influence, mood, or characteristic very clearly. Used mostly figuratively, and most often in the adverbial form {色濃|いろこ}く.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{色濃|いろこ}く⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{色濃|いろこ}く⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧。
examples.english: A town where traces of old Edo remain strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{色濃|いろこ}く⟦{表|あらわ}れている→表れる：14276_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: This work strongly reflects the influence of the place where the author grew up.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色濃|いろこ}く⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (to remain strongly, to linger)
- {色濃|いろこ}く⟦{反映|はんえい}する→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧ (to strongly reflect)
- {色濃|いろこ}く⟦{表|あらわ}れる→表れる：14276_arawareru⟧ (to show clearly)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{色濃|いろこ}い (strongly marked by ~: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{色濃|いろこ}い⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧)

REGISTER:
Written and formal; at home in essays, reviews, and news analysis.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧: rich, strong; also of likelihood ({敗色|はいしょく}⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧, defeat looks likely)
